rca of the issue: CI fix verification: workflows now install backend deps with --extra-index-url pointing at the Emergent index for all four call sites, resolving the emergentintegrations==0.2.0 wheel that PyPI does not host. Reproduction of the two backend jobs and the pip-audit job all succeed independently of the fix. The single unit-test failure surfaced is orthogonal: a guard test (introduced in iter148) forbids hardcoded '/app/...' paths in the tests tree; test_iter202_brain_api.py violates that by directly opening '/app/frontend/.env' to derive BASE_URL. Mitigation: rely on REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL env only (as done by test_iter202_brain_phase_a.py which passes cleanly), or resolve the path via pathlib(__file__).parents[2] / 'frontend' / '.env'.
